title: From Sidelnikov-Welch bounds to projection constants
summary: In the paper, we prove a recursive version of the weighted Sidelnikov-Welch inequality for real and complex unit vectors. Unlike the classical form, which gives a direct lower bound for a fixed even power sum, our inequality relates two consecutive even power sums. Iteration yields the usual weighted Sidelnikov-Welch bound. We apply this estimate to maximal relative projection constants.
